name: Text Diff
description: Compare two texts by line, word or character with side-by-side highlighting and patch export; ignore noise such as timestamps and IDs with regex rules
help: Line mode shows both sides next to each other and highlights the exact words that changed within modified lines.
Word and character modes are handy for spotting small differences in a sentence or a config value.
Ignoring case and whitespace only affects the comparison; the original text is still shown.
“Copy patch” produces a standard unified diff ready for git apply or code review.

Ignore rules: in line mode, text matched by each rule (a regex) is removed from every line before comparing — handy for timestamps, auto-increment IDs and random values. Rules stack with ignore case and whitespace, are saved for next time, and statistics use the normalized result.
truncated: Too many differences; showing the first 20,000 rows
